messages:
liam: deploy-bot alert — canary in eu-west1 showing sudden 5xx spike after the 18:15 deploy. requesting expedited hotfix approval to pin back to v1.2.2 and skip full canary for region-limited patch. @sheila @maya

deploy-bot: [ALERT] Canary failed in eu-west1
- 5xx rate: 7.8% (baseline 3.1%)
- p95 latency: 3.8s (baseline 1.9s)
Action: canary failed. Auto-rollback: false

sheila: can we confirm rollback criteria and blast radius if we pin instead of rollback? need a quick risk call. :warning:

maya: sounds like tokenization commit causing cache misses under surge. pin to v1.2.2 is lower risk than rolling everything back. can patch the tokenizer afterward.

liam: build+smoke ETA ~20m. asking to fasttrack region-only deploy to eu-west1. will throttle traffic.

jason: infra ok for region-limited fasttrack. we can throttle to 30% and enable extra log sampling.

ops-bot: SRE override request submitted to @sheila for expedited deploy bypassing canary. Use `/deploy pin --version=v1.2.2 --regions=eu-west1 --fasttrack` to proceed once approved.

sheila: approved for fasttrack. Conditions: rollback if 5xx > 5% for 5m OR p95 > 3s for 10m. Enable 50% log-sampling and retain traces for 48h. I'll stay on call 30m.

liam: release note (copy for changelog):
```
Hotfix: revert tokenization change causing cache miss storms under heavy concurrent inference.
Action: pin to v1.2.2 in eu-west1 (region-limited)
Risk: low-medium; deploy throttled at 30% traffic
Monitoring: thresholds set for 5xx and p95; 50% log-sampling enabled
```

liam: running deploy now:
```
/deploy pin --version v1.2.2 --regions eu-west1 --fasttrack --notes "revert tokenizer, pin v1.2.2"
```

deploy-bot: Deploy initiated by liam. Job #deploy-3421. Canary skipped by explicit approval. Throttling: 30%

sheila: enabling runbook watch and alert escalation. @oncall please monitor dashboards (latency, 5xx, cache-miss-rate). paging thresholds configured as above.

maya: watching evals and log samples, will call out any regression within 10m.

deploy-bot: Progress: 10% -> 50% -> 100%. No new 5xx spikes observed.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete. v1.2.2 pinned in eu-west1. Job #deploy-3421. :tada:

liam: thanks team — annotating changelog and will follow up with a brief postmortem if we see recurrence.

sheila: marking hotfix resolved. will keep monitoring for the next hour. :white_check_mark:
